hook: Almost nothing launches until the new year. Use the quiet weeks.
items: Get your loan approval in principle<small>Know your real budget before Q1 launches</small>
Shortlist by your exit, not by the showflat<small>Who buys from you later, and at what price</small>
Compare resale and new launch side by side<small>Quiet months can mean more room to negotiate</small>
take: Buyers who prepare in December decide calmly in January.
